summary: The exact candidate fixes both previously reported correction-generation counterexamples, but chunked prefill still changes a request's Equation 2 score and selected neuron relative to the identical one-shot prompt. The original per-request Equation 2 then Equation 3 contract is therefore not fully resolved.

remaining_counterexamples: Chunked prefill is not Equation-2 invariant: one five-token request scored in one forward selects neuron 0, while the identical request split into extend chunks of four and one selects neuron 1 because the candidate max-aggregates per-chunk scores instead of accumulating the full per-request sufficient statistics.
remaining_limitations: No production model weights were available, so production semantic accuracy and throughput were not measured.
Actual HTTP serving with chunked prefill was not run; the deterministic tensor-level manager path establishes the scoring defect directly.
NVIDIA, quantized, biased, TP>1, speculative-decode, and unsupported architecture paths remain unverified or explicitly unsupported.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
